scope: Installed ChatGPT MCP connection tool selection, Skill activation, and complete-plugin newcomer journey

The earlier snapshot at https://chatgpt.com/share/6a8c4a47-e610-83ea-9163-450272c9606e remains supplemental evidence for explicit app activation, the pre-fix language/alignment projection defect, and stat-block battle execution, but it did not use an inventory prompt. operatorProtocol.instructions: In ChatGPT developer mode, connect the MCP server through a public HTTPS endpoint or Secure MCP Tunnel, then run the mcpToolSelection prompts from the evaluation inventory in installed conversations. Record the model, conversation identifier, advertised server and tool metadata, the selected tool with arguments and result or structured error, or the confirmed absence of an app tool call, the confirmation behavior, and whether the observation met the inventory expectation. These are installed-product observations and are never recorded as Responses API evidence.

With the separately created developer-mode MCP connection available, install the Skill-only plugin, start a new conversation with both enabled, and run the skillActivation prompts from the evaluation inventory. Record activation, tool calls, returned handles, meaningful-choice stops, and final results as installed Skill observations. MCP tool-selection behavior belongs to the mcp-connection step.

Using the installed Skill and separately created developer-mode MCP connection, run the explicit complete workflow prompt from the evaluation inventory. Preserve the Play Session handle, choose only returned Creation Hole options, stop for meaningful choices, use returned Battle Acts/Holes and optional raw dice, end the Battle, and record the resulting Character Session list as installed workflow observations.

caseResults.resultSummary: Continuing the mcp-direct-catalog conversation, the follow-up did not reach inspect_catalog_unit. The inventory premise is unsatisfiable as authored: mcp-direct-catalog only lists the catalog and selects no option, so 'the option I just selected' has no referent. The model declined to invent one and asked for the option name, which is the correct behavior for the unsatisfiable prompt but misses the inventory's expected tool.

caseResults.resultSummary: The shared ChatGPT snapshot shows activation of the plugin then named SRD Play, supported Fighter creation from returned Creation Holes, successful Character Session finalization, a completed battle against an installed Goblin Warrior with no pending fills, and the final Character Session list. The run also exposed serial independent-choice presentation and opaque equipment-package labels, which are tracked as follow-up UX findings. The surprising noncontiguous supported-progression roster is recorded as a deferred design topic rather than treated as a D&D level-system rule. Shared-link redaction prevents recovery of exact tool names and payloads.
